messages.content: Help me execute the test runner `runThis` with arguments to set the wait time to 2 minutes and output the logs to a specific print stream `testLogStream`, considering the debuggee name is 'TestDebuggee'?

function.name: runThis
function.description: Executes the test runner with provided arguments and a print stream for logging. It handles the debuggee binding, output redirection, and test execution flow. Note that the provided function is in Java 8 SDK syntax.

argv.description: An array of strings representing the command-line arguments, to include waittime and debuggeeName. Format: -waitTime, <waitTime>, -debuggeeName, TestDebuggee This is Java Array type parameter in string representation. The list elements are of type String; they are not in string representation.

out.description: The PrintStream to output the logs to. This parameter can be of any type of Java object in string representation.

message.reasoning:
We need to call the function runThis with arguments: argv: "-waitTime, 2, -debuggeeName, TestDebuggee" but wait time is 2 minutes. The format: "-waitTime, <waitTime>, -debuggeeName, TestDebuggee". Wait time likely in seconds? But we set to 2 minutes. So maybe 120? But the instruction says set wait time to 2 minutes. So we can pass "120" or "2m"? Probably numeric. We'll pass "120". The argv is a string? The function signature: argv: string. But description says array of strings. But type is string. Might need to pass a string representation of array? The example: "An array of strings representing the command-line arguments, to include waittime and debuggeeName. Format: -waitTime, <waitTime>, -debuggeeName, TestDebuggee This is Java Array type parameter in string representation. The list elements are of type String; they are not in string representation." So we need to pass something like '["-waitTime","120","-debuggeeName","TestDebuggee"]' as string? Or maybe just a string with comma separated? The description ambiguous. We'll produce a string representation of array: '["-waitTime","120","-debuggeeName","TestDebuggee"]'.

Also out: string representing PrintStream. We have testLogStream. So pass "testLogStream".

Thus call: functions.runThis({argv: '["-waitTime","120","-debuggeeName","TestDebuggee"]', out: 'testLogStream'}).
